dp.reasoning: The captured Lua snapshot has no DP sample. The built handler ends in 0E FC, the M6809 JMP direct-page opcode with an 8-bit target FC. At the post-handler breakpoint the live PC is 00FC. A direct-page JMP would target DP:00FC, so observed PC=00FC implies DP=0. LDD, ADDD, STD and JMP do not write DP, so the same DP holds at handler entry 1012. This is a static deduction from exact bytes plus a live PC, not a direct DP measurement.

limitations: MAME success is not physical MPU4 hardware compatibility.
